name: Hai Jia International Limited Company
summary: Hai Jia International Limited Company, headquartered in New York, New York, operates as an independent residential mortgage lender and comprehensive loan service provider. This mortgage banking firm primarily serves both individual borrowers and mortgage brokerage businesses. Its offerings encompass a variety of financial solutions, including initial and secondary mortgage loans, options for refinancing existing mortgages, and home equity lines of credit, all processed through its dedicated loan production department. The company also extends both direct-to-consumer (retail) and bulk (wholesale) lending programs. Through its sophisticated online systems, Hai Jia International provides convenient access for individuals seeking to purchase or refinance their homes, as well as for brokers aiming to support their clientele. The company extends its services to consumers and mortgage professionals across 31 U.S. states, supported by around ten branch locations spread across Louisiana, Texas, Nevada, California, Florida, Georgia, and Washington. Prior to May 2021, the entity operated under the name Trinity Capital Partners, Inc., before rebranding to its current designation.
